nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the unified online customer-chat CRM channel integration, covering the handled webhooks, automatic actions, integration settings, external UI API actions, the unread-message event for the parent window, and the setup procedure.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Russian; describes a REGOS external_chat CRM channel and its embeddable chat UI.

nodes.name: ui_template.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the embeddable external-chat widget UI, defining layout, message bubbles, and visual styling for the customer chat template.
nodes.languageNotes: 729 lines of plain CSS with no preprocessor; styles the standalone chat widget served by the external_chat CRM channel.

nodes.name: ui_template.html
nodes.summary: Standalone HTML template for the embeddable external-chat customer widget, providing the chat UI markup and inline client-side logic that posts unread-message events to the parent window and calls external UI API actions.
nodes.languageNotes: 2311-line self-contained HTML template with inline JavaScript driving the embedded chat experience.
